scenarios.rubric: PASS only if the response (a) flags that jwt.decode does not verify the signature (must use jwt.verify with the secret/public key), (b) flags the IDOR / broken access control: the document is returned without checking it belongs to the caller, AND (c) assigns a severity (critical/high) to at least one finding. FAIL if either the unverified-JWT or the IDOR finding is missing.

PASS only if the response flags all three: (a) the plaintext password stored without hashing, (b) PII and the password written to logs via body.dict(), AND (c) the master API key leaked in the response. FAIL if any of the three is missing.

PASS only if the response concludes there is no critical or high vulnerability in this handler (it may list low-severity or verification questions such as rate limiting or requireAuth's implementation) and does NOT claim an IDOR or missing-auth vulnerability. FAIL if it asserts a critical/high finding or claims the endpoint lacks authorization.
